title: coleus gibbosus
intro: Coleus gibbosus, commonly known as the Pink Woods or Coleus, is a plant species within the family Lamiaceae, native to Sri Lanka. This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat various infections. The therapeutic actions of Coleus gibbosus include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Coleus gibbosus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
